race.comment: WIZARD'S STAR (1) filled a placing in a Class 1 over 2000m two back then found the mile a bit sharp at Kembla last Saturday. Like to step up in distance on a seven-day turnaround. Well-placed to finally break the maiden at start 13. ROYAL PRINCESS (5) led and gave a great sight but was claimed by a couple right near the line last time out over 2100m at Gosford. Very fit mare who is nicely placed after the claim and will give them something to catch. OCEAN PREDATOR (14) raced near the speed but lacked the turn of foot required when fourth on debut over 1500m at Muswellbrook recently. Bred to want a staying trip so this looks a nice progression. ROBBED BY ROB (15) chimed in late but missed the maiden win by a whisker last start over the mile at Newcastle. Perfectly placed over an extra 300m at the third run of the campaign. WHO I THINK I AM (3) is going okay but should go to another level with this step up in distance.
